runner_hardening.direct_parent_regression: P4.5 runner executes committed P4.4 acceptance test directly after P4.4 lifecycle acceptance instead of recursively replaying older parent runners
runner_hardening.process_api: System.Diagnostics.Process with asynchronous stdout/stderr draining and exit code read after timed WaitForExit
runner_hardening.timeout_behavior: fail closed and terminate Godot process tree
runner_hardening.reason: avoid the Windows PowerShell Start-Process null ExitCode failure observed in the P4.4 gate

contract.ownership_identity: canonical owner state binds P4.4 snapshot hash, region id, owner server id and monotonic integer ownership_epoch
contract.fencing: ownership_epoch increments exactly once per accepted handoff; old owner/epoch/hash claims fail against the new canonical state
contract.cas_mutation: snapshot mutation requires exact owner server, epoch, ownership hash and current snapshot hash; successful mutation keeps epoch but rotates ownership_hash
contract.handoff_prepare: prepare_handoff is deterministic and read-only, carries the exact current P4.4 snapshot and binds the exact source ownership hash
contract.handoff_accept: accept_handoff is compare-and-swap against current source ownership, increments epoch by one and preserves snapshot bytes/identity
contract.replay: a handoff package cannot be applied twice and becomes stale if the source snapshot changes after preparation
contract.continuity: advance-before-handoff and handoff-before-advance converge to the same ownership identity when the same canonical future P4.4 snapshot is committed
contract.identity_scope: no wall clock, lease duration, network address or process-local object id enters canonical ownership hashes

targeted_exact_attached_godot_evidence.boundary_note: targeted runtime uses a minimal deterministic P4.4 snapshot validator stub with the frozen real P4.4 snapshot hash; this proves P4.5 ownership semantics but is not full-chain lifecycle acceptance evidence
